assumptions.statement: The repository offers one rough provisional overall polygon and three rough rectangular key-area carriers, not official redlines, parcels or survey geometry.
assumptions.impact: All nine geometry layers, metrics, figures, PDFs and HTML must be regenerated after canonical geometry is published.

assumptions.statement: The taskbook names Dazhongsi, but PROV-KEY-003 is not reliably anchored to the real Dazhongsi station-city relationship.
assumptions.impact: No station exit, quadrant, street segment, distance, capacity, title, pilot or implementation claim is permitted from the temporary polygon.

assumptions.statement: Statutory land use, title, buildings, road redlines, utilities, heritage, fire, evacuation, accessibility and approved development controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Land-use bands and interface footprints are non-statutory concept carriers; retain-renovate-demolish, FAR, height and engineering remain UNKNOWN.

assumptions.statement: No verified traffic, equipment, activity, emission or heat source inventory is available for a candidate transect.
assumptions.impact: Source-path-receiver diagrams are hypotheses; a named professional source inventory is required before B0.

assumptions.statement: No authorised paired section, calibrated/co-located measurement baseline, weather matching or agreed no-harm threshold exists.
assumptions.impact: No heat, air-exchange, noise, comfort, accessibility or public-use benefit is claimed.

assumptions.statement: No venue, owner, operator, professional reviewer, insurer, maintainer or restoration authority is represented as committed.
assumptions.impact: Current implementation state is UNKNOWN / NO-GO; AI cannot advance it.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day sequence is a falsifiable authorisation-and-evidence contract, not an announced programme.
assumptions.impact: It may remain desk-based, shrink, stop or restore when any authority, safety, comparability or maintenance gate fails.

assumptions.statement: Design-time AI may fail to find an explainable, stable and professionally acceptable non-dominated alternative to the manual-rule B1 baseline.
assumptions.impact: If AI adds no stable net value, delete AI and retain B1 passive form without changing the public service.

assumptions.statement: No actual reduction in heat exposure, pollution, noise, energy, illness or complaint is measured or promised.
assumptions.impact: E0-E2 support only a conceptual C-S package; C-I stays HOLD until E3/E4 evidence exists.

assumptions.statement: Official public records identify Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park Phase I Section C between Zhichun Road and the North Fourth Ring, but provide no project transect, measured source/path/receiver section or pilot authority.
assumptions.impact: Section C is an evidence-segment candidate for an authorisation request, not a selected pilot, canonical key-area polygon, surveyed section or performance baseline.

assumptions.statement: The official emergency-shelter register records Phase I Section C as a Category III site for earthquake response with other hazards considered.
assumptions.impact: No concept, temporary component or measurement setup may weaken emergency shelter, evacuation, fire access or barrier-free continuity; qualified emergency/fire/access review precedes any real work.

assumptions.statement: The 2025 Beijing park directory lists Haidian District Park Management Center as the competent unit for the named park entry.
assumptions.impact: It is a documented candidate contact in the authorisation path, not evidence of consent, responsibility assignment, funding or a pilot commitment.

assumptions.statement: No supplier quotation, bill of quantities, labour agreement, insurance advice or restoration price has been obtained.
assumptions.impact: The package states cost buckets and quantity bases only; a monetary ceiling requires an authorised transect and comparable quotations or applicable procurement basis.

assumptions.statement: No named routine inspection, planting, cleaning, temporary-component, instrument or complaint-response team exists.
assumptions.impact: A pilot cannot open, remain open or be restored without named duties, frequencies, logs and absence cover.

assumptions.statement: The minimum evidence model excludes names, faces, images, health status, precise individual location, workplace identity and continuous trajectories.
assumptions.impact: Only authorised section/object records, aggregated time bands and professional evidence are allowed; prohibited data discovery is an immediate stop-and-delete event.

assumptions.statement: The attributed ODbL OpenStreetMap snapshot is a dated public orientation and section-index layer, not a canonical or surveyed base.
assumptions.impact: OSM features and counts may document package coverage only; they prove no current condition, official boundary, title, accessible route, fire condition, source inventory, operating fact or authorisation.

assumptions.statement: Six global cases are documented through 30 first-party sources to test mechanisms, limits and spatial consequences, not to rank brands or transfer outcome claims.
assumptions.impact: Only the audited mechanism fields may inform the Jing-Zhang contract; institution counts, investment scales, policy powers and claimed success do not become local targets or commitments.

assumptions.statement: RACI seats, alternates, SLO targets, negative tests, Level-0 BoQ, symbolic cost ceilings and the Section-C interlock are an unsigned E0 control template.
assumptions.impact: Every signable primary and alternate remains UNKNOWN; no target is current performance, and no physical work is released until the applicable E3/E4 evidence is signed.

assumptions.statement: The cutaway triptych was generated without input/reference images and expresses sealed, straight-through and staggered conditions as an abstract hypothesis.
assumptions.impact: It is not a site photograph, survey, canonical geometry, simulation result, construction drawing, approval or performance evidence.
